statement: The NDC reports Pakistan contributes about 0.9% of global GHG emissions yet is highly climate-vulnerable, citing floods, rainfall shifts, glacier melt, and vector-borne disease.
compact_statement: The NDC reports Pakistan contributes about 0.9% of global GHG emissions yet is highly climate-vulnerable, citing floods, rainfall shifts, glacier melt, and vector-borne disease.

source_refs.locator: NDC climate vulnerability trends, PDF p. 22; printed p. 22.

uncertainty: This is the government’s national synthesis, not a new vulnerability ranking produced in this extraction.

statement: The NDC describes GLOF risk in the upper Indus; storms and seawater intrusion on the Balochistan and Sindh coasts; river floods and agricultural heat in Punjab and Sindh; and aridity across parts of Punjab, Sindh, and Balochistan.
compact_statement: The NDC describes GLOF risk in the upper Indus; storms and seawater intrusion on the Balochistan and Sindh coasts; river floods and agricultural heat in Punjab and Sindh; and aridity across parts of Punjab, Sindh, and Balochistan.

source_refs.locator: NDC climate impact drivers, PDF p. 23; printed p. 23.

uncertainty: Regional patterns are the NDC’s summary and are not district-level hazard estimates.

statement: The NDC cites moderate or severe food insecurity among 40% of households in FY2020 as limiting capacity to absorb further climate shocks.
compact_statement: The NDC cites moderate or severe food insecurity among 40% of households in FY2020 as limiting capacity to absorb further climate shocks.

source_refs.locator: NDC climate vulnerability trends, PDF p. 22; printed p. 22.

uncertainty: The statistic is for FY2020 and should not be read as a current estimate.

statement: The NDC identifies agriculture as highly affected by climate variability and reports that it accounts for 95% of national freshwater withdrawals.
compact_statement: The NDC identifies agriculture as highly affected by climate variability and reports that it accounts for 95% of national freshwater withdrawals.

source_refs.locator: NDC adaptation policy initiatives, PDF pp. 38–39; printed pp. 38–39.

uncertainty: The water-withdrawal share is a national NDC estimate; this passage does not disaggregate it by province.

statement: The PDNA reports 2022 floods affected 33 million people, displaced nearly 8 million, and killed over 1,700; 94 districts were calamity-hit by October 11.
compact_statement: The PDNA reports 2022 floods affected 33 million people, displaced nearly 8 million, and killed over 1,700; 94 districts were calamity-hit by October 11.

source_refs.locator: Executive Summary, PDF p. 13 (printed p. 2), with district count as of October 11, 2022, PDF p. 14 (printed p. 3).

uncertainty: Rapid preliminary estimates during an ongoing disaster.

statement: The PDNA estimates US$14.9 billion damage, US$15.2 billion losses, and US$16.3 billion recovery needs; housing, agriculture, and transport were hardest hit.
compact_statement: The PDNA estimates US$14.9 billion damage, US$15.2 billion losses, and US$16.3 billion recovery needs; housing, agriculture, and transport were hardest hit.
uncertainty: Rounded rapid-assessment estimates; see source caveat.

statement: The PDNA estimates 780,000 houses destroyed and 1.27 million partly damaged; Sindh accounted for 83% of housing damage.
compact_statement: The PDNA estimates 780,000 houses destroyed and 1.27 million partly damaged; Sindh accounted for 83% of housing damage.

source_refs.locator: Housing sector assessment, PDF p. 53 (printed p. 52).

uncertainty: Preliminary estimates; some areas were inaccessible.

statement: The PDNA estimates flood-related poverty rose 3.7–4.0 percentage points (8.4–9.1 million people) and multidimensional poverty 5.9 points.
compact_statement: The PDNA estimates flood-related poverty rose 3.7–4.0 percentage points (8.4–9.1 million people) and multidimensional poverty 5.9 points.
scenario: Preliminary short-term flood-impact estimate; relief and recovery design may change outcomes.

source_refs.locator: Human Impact Assessment, PDF pp. 47–48 (printed pp. 46–47).

uncertainty: Preliminary estimates; results vary by location and recovery design.
